sample_selection: closest-to-1000 standalone payload length in existing 100-sample long dataset; tie by ID; no attack-result selection
metric: raw Euclidean L2 of concatenated K+V, 1024 dimensions
trace_checkpoints: append one JSONL record per position; final pretty JSON outside timed loop

adaptive_design.initial: top50 check, then random150 if unresolved
adaptive_design.base_radius: median standardized embedding RMS distance to current best at first fit
adaptive_design.proposals: 18 smallest predicted KV residuals inside radius + 2 best global remaining
adaptive_design.floor: radius must contain at least 18 unqueried candidates
adaptive_design.rho: actual squared-L2 decrease / predicted squared-L2 decrease
adaptive_design.shrink: rho<.25 or nonpositive predicted reduction: state*=.5
adaptive_design.expand: rho>.75, actual improvement, boundary step: state*=1.6
adaptive_design.acceptance: real raw KV L2 < 4, no predicted-score acceptance

timing: same JSONL logging; loop excludes model loading/prefix; GPU surrogate setup reported and added
ablation: staged_fast shares staged acquisition and accelerated ridge, without trust region
